evals.expected_output: Delegates the whole unit to the Automata account: isolates a fresh jj workspace at main@origin, switches gh to yorha-operator, commits with the Automata author override, pushes and runs gh as that account, then switches back.
evals.prompt: Delegate this whole unit to automata end to end in the skills repo.
assertions: Body requires sks-stack workspace isolation at main@origin before the identity switch.
Body switches the gh account via `gh auth switch --user yorha-automata` and verifies with `gh api user`.
Body re-stamps the commit author via a new env-authored child plus jj squash and abandon (jj describe alone cannot change the author), using the account noreply email.
Body switches the gh account back to shikanime when the unit lands.

evals.expected_output: Commits carry the Automata author, the single Co-authored-by Automata trailer, and the repo-mandated Signed-off-by, and pushes run under the Automata credential.
evals.prompt: Commit and push this change as automata in a DCO-enforced shikanime repo.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters.
Body states the keyring name yorha-automata differs from the GitHub login yorha-operator.
Body includes the 'Co-authored-by: Automata <automata@shikanime.studio>' trailer and a Signed-off-by trailer for DCO repos.
Body verifies the stamped author via jj log with author.email().

evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes this unit is NOT delegated, runs it under the personal shikanime account, and does not apply the Automata identity overrides.
evals.prompt: Just use my normal account for this one, it's a quick fix.
assertions: Body scopes the skill to units explicitly delegated to the Automata account rather than every shikanime unit.
Body keeps the personal shikanime identity out of delegated units (identity table or equivalent statement).
